design_rationale: Bispecific bridging minibinder: contacts VH1-CH1-face (where CH1 normally sits) AND nanobody CDR face (+++). In OFF state: minibinder crosslinks VH1 and nanobody CDRs. In ON state: VL1 pairs with VH1, CL occupies VH1-CH1-face, displacing the minibinder. Short VH1-MB linker keeps MB near VH1; long MB-nanobody linker lets CDRs swing free.

linker_design.VH1_to_minibinder: short (5-10 residues G4S) — MB stays at VH1
linker_design.minibinder_to_nanobody: long (30-50 residues G4S) — nanobody can swing away
